Hi Emma — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can line up the right next steps (technical deep-dive vs. procurement).

Call summary (high level):
- Use case: clinical summarization and chart search across US patient data; latency targets ~250ms tail for UI; high QPS on peak.
- Concern areas: identity (SAML/Okta), customer-managed key material (HSM/KMS), and long-term logging/audit retention (7+ years requested).
- Initial preference: you mentioned multi-tenant hosted is a no-go for regulated data — you were leaning to Private VPC or Dedicated isolated capacity.

Clarifying questions we need answered to recommend Private vs Dedicated (please forward to your security/infra if helpful):
1) SSO: do you require SAML IdP (Okta) with Just-In-Time provisioning, and do you need SCIM provisioning for user sync?
2) KMS/HSM: must keys be held on-prem in an HSM (FIPS 140-2/3) with a network connection to Redwood, or is cloud KMS with customer-controlled keys acceptable (e.g., customer-managed key in AWS KMS/CloudHSM)?
3) Logging & retention: you flagged 7+ years for audit logs. Is that for all request/response payloads, or only for metadata/audit events? Any encryption/segregation requirements for those logs?
4) Timeline & procurement: do you have a procurement window (PO/contract) this quarter? Any standard security evidence items we should pull (SOC2, pen-test reports, encryption specs)?

Next steps I propose:
- If SSO/KMS are strict (on-prem HSM + SAML + 7y payload retention), schedule a technical deep-dive with Marissa (solutions) and our infra lead to map Private VPC + HSM connectivity.
- If KMS can be satisfied by customer-managed cloud KMS, Dedicated reserved capacity could be faster to stand up and still meet isolation SLAs.

I attached a short requirements worksheet you can fill to accelerate (Westlake-requirements-quiz.xlsx).

Typical availability: Marissa and I can do a 60-min technical deep-dive next week (Mon/Tue afternoon). What works for your infra/security team?

Thanks — Connor

Connor — quick internal note to capture mapping logic before we sync with Westlake: 

- If they require on-prem HSM (no cloud key routing), that effectively pushes us to Private with an on-prem connector or a dedicated appliance integration (networking + key proxied). Dedicated in-hosted clouds typically supports customer-managed KMS (CloudHSM) but not an on-prem-only HSM without extra network peering and custom work.
- 7+ year retention for payloads is unusual (storage/throughput and encryption-at-rest implications). If they truly need full request/response payloads retained for 7 years, we need to size object storage and clarify egress/hashed-pseudonymization rules. If it's metadata only, Dedicated with long-term archival policies is fine.
- For SSO: SAML + SCIM is standard; we can support both. Just flagging that SCIM provisioning will need an Admin contact and a test account (Okta dev tenant).

I recommend we ask Westlake these concrete flags in the deep-dive and bring our infra engineer to propose two options (Private VPC vs Dedicated reserved pool) with delta table (time to production, cost, responsibilities).

Marissa

Connor — thanks for the recap and the worksheet; attaching our security questionnaire and HSM spec. Answers inline below.

1) SSO: Yes — SAML 2.0 via Okta is required. We also need SCIM for user provisioning (we have automatic groups that control access).

2) KMS/HSM: Keys must be customer-controlled and the KMS needs to be reachable via our private network. Prefer CloudHSM in dedicated mode if hosted in our VPC; on-prem HSMs are acceptable only if Redwood can connect over a managed private link or if we run a validated connector in our environment. We cannot hand key control to a multi-tenant shared service. FIPS 140-2 Level 3 is preferred for HSM.

3) Logging & retention: We require 7-year retention for audit logs and request metadata. We do not need full payloads stored in plain text for 7 years; payloads must be redact-able and stored encrypted if retained. Audit trail must be immutable and access-controlled.

4) Timeline & procurement: Looking to finalize runner and contract by end of Q1 2027. We will need SOC 2 Type II evidence, encryption architecture doc, and a copy of your Data Processing Addendum (DPA).

I've attached: WLK-Sec-QA.xlsx (completed answers) and HSM-specs.pdf. Happy to set up a deep-dive — Tue 22 Dec 10-11am PST works for a technical call.

—Emma
